'''Sona Ziemba''' lived on Alderaan, and informed [[Ferus Olin]] about native flowers which only bloom for one day in Alderaan, and about the festival that is held on that day. She was later interrogated by Ferus and [[Hydra (Grand Inquisitor)|Hydra]] about whether she knew anything about a [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Force-Sensitive toddler]]. She had a husband named [[Dartan Ziemba|Dartan]] and a [[Gender/Legends|female]] child named [[Tula Ziemba|Tula]].
